> It'll be a wall of boxes like organizers. There will be a xy gantry system that will fetch boxes. There will be a large screen with controls that will show all the inventory information and allow you to automatically fetch certain items. There will also be LEDs on each box slot that shows whether its filled or not. There will also be an LED matrix  / segment display that shows how  many boxes are out of stock.
